title: Alphabet Deep Dive Analysis
coverage_note: Read every section and heatmap inventory. Covers fiscal outlook, bonds/mortgages, Bitcoin governance and regulation, Alphabet valuation, competition, capital allocation and antitrust. Historical breakout recap is linked to prior forecasts, not counted anew.

claims.reason: The confident post-election update expected an uneventful TGA. Instead debt-ceiling constraints lasted into July 2025 and cash fell substantially. This stronger revision is less defensible than the earlier probability caveat.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify the proposed causal mechanism.

assessment: The confident post-election no-TGA-drain update was contradicted. QT timing, tax-rate extension, regulatory easing and Alphabet resilience were supported. Alphabet avoided the feared breakup, but attributing that result to political leniency would be wrong. AI capital spending remains a major return-on-investment question.
